usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with JSON body {model, messages[]} (OpenAI-compatible chat completions)
quirks: Standard OpenAI-compatible chat completions shape — must include model:"google/gemini-3.1-pro" in the body.
Price varies by token usage; a tiny hello prompt (91 prompt + 9 completion tokens) cost ~$0.0104 USDC on Base.
usage.guide: Call POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with an OpenAI-style JSON body containing model:"google/gemini-3.1-pro" and a messages array. Payment is x402 USDC on Base, charged per token, settled synchronously. Read the assistant reply from body.choices[0].message.content and token counts from body.usage. No API key or sign-in needed — the wallet pays per request.
